content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that the Time to Live (TTL) value for the encapsulating IPv4 tunnel header was not being set correctly, resulting in a TTL of 0. This occurred because, prior to the support of Geneve tunnel encapsulation, the TTL value was extracted from the tunnel key, but this mechanism was removed, leading to the default TTL not being set. The patch fixes this by explicitly setting the TTL to the default value defined in the network namespace for each new tunnel, ensuring that the firmware requirements are met.
